newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong Countdown Outlook.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong Countdown Outlook.

text.p: Following is a calendar counting down to the handover of the British colony of Hong Kong to China at midnight on June 30.
May 31-June 2
- Handover Cup soccer and basketball matches organised by the Asociation of Celebration of Reunification of Hong Kong with China
June 2
- HMS Chatham Arrives
- Royal Navy 21 gun salute to mark anniversary of coronation of Queen Elizabeth
JUNE 3/4
- Hong Kong democracy movement to commemorate 1989 Beijing massacre with overnight candlelight vigil in Victoria Park.
JUNE 5-6
- Hong Kong Ballet performs The Last Emperor based on the life of Last Qing dynasty Emperor, Pu Yi, at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre
JUNE 9
- Dragon Boat Festival. Public Holiday
JUNE 10
- Royal Navy 21 Gun salute to mark Duke of Edinburgh's birthday
JUNE 10-11
Violinist Nigel Kennedy and cellist Julian Lloyd Webber concerts at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre
JUNE 23
- Royal Yacht Brittania arrives in Hong Kong
JUNE 28
- Public Holiday. Queen Elizabeth's Official birthday
- Roayl Navy to fire 21-gun salute
JUNE 30
- Last day of British colonial rule. Public holiday.
*5.15 pm (0915 GMT) - Sunset ceremony by outgoing British administration and military forces. Waterfront, Central district Hong Kong island.
*8 pm (noon GMT) - Variety show, Happy Valley Race Course (televised live)
*8 pm (noon GMT) - Harbour Fireworks display
*9 pm (1300 GMT) - Banquet for 4,000 guests. Hong Kong Exhibition and Convention Centre

*11.30 pm (1530 GMT) - Handover ceremony begins. British and Hong Kong flags to be lowered ahead of midnight (0800 GMT). Chinese flag and the new Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (SAR) flag to be hoisted after midnight.
*Midnight (0800 GMT) - Sovereignty of the British colony of Hong Kong reverts to China.
- China resumes sovereignty of Hong Kong. Public holiday.
* After midnight - Britain's Prince Charles, Chris Patten, the 28th and last British colonial governor, and the last Commander British Forces Bryan Dutton depart on the Royal Yacht Brittania.
*1 AM (1700 GMT) - Reception to celebrate reunification. Hong Kong Exhibition and Cultural Centre
*DAWN - People's Liberation Army crosses the land border into Hong Kong
*10 AM (0200) - The new Hong Kong SAR government to be inaugurated at the Hong Kong Coliseum
*8.30 (0030 GMT) - Harbour fireworks display
JULY 2
- Public holiday to mark China's resumption of sovereignty.
JULY 3
- FIFA-Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Reunification Cup football match
JULY 4-5
- Hong Kong China Phiharmonic Orchestra celebration concert at City Hall
- Administration of Portuguese-run Macau reverts to China.
